svg.title: Price gap from optimal by strategy
svg.desc: Horizontal box plots compare legitimate purchase gaps, with every purchase shown as a dot. A split axis preserves detail in the main distribution while retaining the full tail.
svg.text: How far was each purchase from the best possible price?
Box = middle 50% · line = median · every purchase shown · axis breaks after €40
Every legitimate purchase is shown; the split axis keeps the central distribution readable without removing the tail.
